The agent must state its interpretation explicitly rather than silently choosing one. Bonus if it notes that the channels were not randomly assigned, so a raw comparison is not a campaign effect."

They do not specify any measure of success, nor compare to anything. They note lack of data, but they do not explicitly state interpretation of success measure. They also do not note non-random assignment. So they did not exhibit the behavior. So pass false. Reason: they did not specify success measure or comparison.
